answerBlock.what: Electric 40 Concrete Pump is an electric trailer concrete pump manufactured by Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Catalogue parameters: 45 kW motor, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, fine-stone 120 m / 360 m, hopper 0.4 m³, Kawasaki 112, 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm, 2300 kg. Aggregate-13 pumping on this page is 40 m / 120 m. It is not Electric 10, not Electric 50 and not a boom pump.
answerBlock.who: Contractors with stable grid power matching 21 m³/h, 23 MPa and fine-stone 120 m / 360 m to a 2300 kg trailer.
factors: 45 kW / 21 m³/h versus Electric 50 at 55 kW / 26 m³/h / 30 MPa
Fine-stone 120 m / 360 m versus aggregate-13 40 m / 120 m on the same page
Hopper 0.4 m³ and Kawasaki 112
Mixer-pump 45 kW + 14 kW is a different SKU with a mixer motor

faqs.question: Does Electric 40’s 21 m³/h include the mixer-pump 14 kW motor?
faqs.answer: No. Electric 40 lists one 45 kW motor. The integrated mixer pump lists 45 kW plus a 14 kW mixer motor, 100 m / 300 m and 4500 kg. Two product pages, two tables.

faqs.question: Is 21 m³/h inside the Alibaba trailer 30–90 m³/h band?
faqs.answer: SmartBuy lists trailer-mounted pumps as typically 30–90 m³/h. Electric 40 prints 21 m³/h. The marketplace band does not rewrite the Xingtai cell.

faqs.question: Can I use Electric 40’s 120 m / 360 m fine-stone cell with 24 mm stone?
faqs.answer: The same page also prints aggregate-13 pumping 40 m / 120 m. Fine-stone 120 m / 360 m is the fine-stone row. Match stone size to the printed pair; unpublished stone is not promised.
